_about: Device fingerprints known to ship with default credentials, from vendors' own published manuals/docs. Used ONLY to report 'this looks like model X, which ships with default login Y: change it'. Watchtower never tries these credentials. 'match' is a case-insensitive regex over the host's fingerprint text (nmap product/version/extrainfo/device type, http-title and server headers, hostnames, MAC vendor).
